description: The FireMonkey counterpart of vcl_21. A caption that outgrows its control by a wide margin has to be given room, and that is a rule about text and boxes rather than about a windowing toolkit. FireMonkey measures through TTextLayout where the VCL measures through GDI, so the two frameworks do not agree to the pixel on what a string needs; what they must agree on is that a control which cannot hold its caption at any readable size is given more room. The geometry is the VCL fixture's, in points rather than in negative pixel heights.
